title: silent command window
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- ScreenGui
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "Gui9999"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = playerGui

-- Frame
local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
Frame.Parent = ScreenGui
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.618693113, 7, 0.852904797, -258)
Frame.Rotation = 1
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 246, 0, 109)

-- TextBox
local TextBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
TextBox.Parent = Frame
TextBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.737255, 0.737255, 0.737255)
TextBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
TextBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.376146793, 0)
TextBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 246, 0, 68)
TextBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
TextBox.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
TextBox.Text = "type in me!"
TextBox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
TextBox.TextSize = 27

-- TextLabel
local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
TextLabel.Parent = Frame
TextLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
TextLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0
TextLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.0243865084, 0, 0.164176613, 0)
TextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 23)
TextLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
TextLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
TextLabel.TextSize = 14

-- Close button
local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
close.Name = "close"
close.Parent = Frame
close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
close.BorderSizePixel = 0
close.Position = UDim2.new(0.83739835, 0, 0, 0)
close.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 41)
close.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
close.Text = "x"
close.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
close.TextScaled = true
close.TextWrapped = true

-- Set player name
TextLabel.Text = player.Name .. " gui 9999 v56"

-- Send textbox text to server
TextBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
	if enterPressed then
		ReplicatedStorage["01_server"]:FireServer("cmd", TextBox.Text)
		TextBox.Text = ""
	end
end)

-- Close GUI
close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)
